name: Intercom Fin
summary: Intercom's AI customer agent for service, sales and e-commerce, billed per resolved outcome.
description: Fin is Intercom's AI agent for customer service, also configured for sales, e-commerce and customer success. It answers across chat, email and voice, follows company procedures and works with helpdesks including Intercom, Zendesk and Salesforce. Pricing is $0.99 per outcome, with an option bundling the Intercom helpdesk from $19 per seat per month; a 14-day free trial is offered. More than 12,000 companies use Fin, according to the site.

howToUse.title: Open Intercom Fin
howToUse.description: Open Intercom Fin and start the free trial, or view a demo. The trial lasts 14 days. The site counts more than 12,000 companies on Fin.

howToUse.title: Set Fin up for the customer role
howToUse.description: Configure the agent for customer service, and also for sales, e-commerce, or customer success when those roles apply. Fin answers across chat, email, and voice, and it follows company procedures.

howToUse.title: Connect a helpdesk
howToUse.description: Connect a helpdesk Fin already works with, including Intercom, Zendesk, or Salesforce. The page also names Freshdesk and HubSpot.

howToUse.title: Price the work by outcome
howToUse.description: Pricing is $0.99 per outcome. An option that bundles the Intercom helpdesk starts at $19 per seat per month.
